# Press Release Details


## Press Release Details


# LGI Homes & Terrata Homes Launches “Make Your Move” National Sales Event with Limited-Time Savings and Incentives


Sep 21, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT


[PDF Version](https://investor.lgihomes.com/node/18871/pdf)


##### The Make Your Move National Sales Event is Back!


Take Advantage of Limited-Time Deals on Move-in Ready Homes


THE WOODLANDS, Texas, Sept. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LGI Homes, Inc. (NASDAQ: LGIH), one of the nation’s leading homebuilders, announced that its **Make Your Move National Sales Event** is now underway, giving homebuyers across the country access to limited-time savings and incentives on select move-in ready homes on LGI Homes and Terrata Homes.


The national sales event began September 18 and features opportunities designed to make purchasing a new home more attainable. At LGI Homes communities, buyers can take advantage of incentives on select inventory, including builder-paid closing costs, included upgrades and special interest rate incentives. With a variety of move-in ready homes available, buyers have the opportunity to find a new home and move-in before the holiday season while taking advantage of these limited-time offers.


Through LGI Homes’ luxury brand, Terrata Homes, buyers can also take advantage of **$25,000 in Flex Cash** on select homes during the Make Your Move event. Flex Cash provides buyers with added flexibility to put their savings toward eligible options based on their homebuying needs.


“The Make Your Move Sales Event is about giving buyers more opportunities to make homeownership a reality,” said Eric Lipar, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of LGI Homes. “From valuable savings and financing incentives to move-in ready homes with upgrades already included, we are proud to offer buyers even more reasons to make their move into a new home.”


LGI Homes is known for its simplified homebuying process and commitment to providing exceptional value. Across communities nationwide, buyers can explore thoughtfully designed homes featuring desirable upgrades, functional floor plans and convenient locations.


The **Make Your Move National Sales Event** is available for a limited time at LGI Homes and Terrata Homes communities nationwide. Homebuyers are encouraged to visit a participating community to tour available move-in ready homes and learn more about incentives available in their market.


**About LGI Homes**


Headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas, LGI Homes, Inc. is a pioneer in the homebuilding industry, successfully applying an innovative and systematic approach to the design, construction and sale of homes across 36 markets in 21 states. LGI Homes has closed over 80,000 homes since its founding in 2003 and has delivered profitable financial results every year. Nationally recognized for its quality construction and exceptional customer service, LGI Homes was named to Newsweek’s list of the World’s Most Trustworthy Companies. LGI Homes’ commitment to excellence extends to its more than 1,000 employees, earning the Company numerous workplace awards at the local, state, and national level, including the Top Workplaces USA 2025 Award. For more information about LGI Homes and its unique operating model focused on making the dream of homeownership a reality for families across the nation, please visit the Company’s website at www.lgihomes.com.
